units.source_text: “是真一的哥哥，在龙村……他告诉我，真一那里，他父亲的生意很兴隆，店里有两个好伙计。

en.t: "It was Shinichi's older brother, in Tatsumura... He told me that at Shinichi's place, his father's business was thriving, and there were two good workers in the shop.

units.source_text: 他说要是植村不干，他们可以调一个给我们，甚至还说他自己也来帮忙。”

en.t: He said that if Uemura would not do it, they could send one of them over to us, and he even said he himself would come to help."
